result.summary: In 2025 Hassabis kept dating AGI to roughly five to ten years (All-In in September, Axios in December). He also said 'three to five years' in a January Q&A and 'just after' 2030 at Google I/O in May. He gave shorter dated forecasts for missing breakthroughs (about five years), a robotics 'wow moment' (a couple of years) and much faster drug discovery (ten years); none of the seven new items is on the recorded list, though the robotics line repeats the recorded April claim's gist.

reply_text:
I found seven new dated predictions from 2025 that aren't on your recorded list, plus one undated AGI remark. None of them is a recorded claim met again, though the All-In robotics line says nearly the same thing as your April robotics file. Six of the seven come from a transcript or a printed Q&A; one comes only from news coverage.

- **January (Big Technology Q&A, published 23 January).** Asked whether AGI was a couple of years off, he said "I think we're probably three to five years away." Earlier in the same piece he said AGI was "still probably a handful of years away," which I've listed as undated. The post went up on 23 January 2025, but I can't confirm the day the interview was recorded.
- **Google I/O, May 2025 (third-party transcript).** Asked whether AGI would come before or after 2030, he said "I'm just after." The transcript doesn't give the day. I believe the session was on 20 May but didn't confirm it, so I've dated it 2025-05.
- **All-In Summit, September 2025 (third-party transcript).** He gave four dated forecasts:
  - AGI is "sort of five to 10 years away".
  - One or two missing breakthroughs "will come over the next five or so years".
  - There will be "a sort of real wow moment with robotics" in "the next couple of years". This is close to your April robotics file.
  - Drug discovery could fall from years "down to maybe weeks or even days over the next 10 years".
  
  The transcript page dates the interview 13 September.
- **Axios AI+ Summit, 4 December 2025 (news coverage only).** He said AGI is "Quite close. I think we're like 5 to 10 years away if you were to ask me," speaking to Mike Allen at the Axios AI+ SF Summit in San Francisco on Thursday.

**Left out:**
- **Isomorphic Labs (All-In).** He said its drug programmes would enter a pre-clinical phase "sometime next year". That's the company's own pipeline plan, so I treated it as a business forecast.
- **TIME100 profile, April.** It paraphrases him on AGI and quotes only the fragment "a few years away", about an agent that could automate AI research. That isn't dated, and it isn't about AGI arriving.
- **Davos and Paris debates with Dario Amodei.** The 2025 Paris transcript is behind a paywall, so I didn't use it. The January 2026 Davos text belongs under other years.
- **CNBC, 17 March.** I saw this report only in search snippets and didn't open the page, so I haven't quoted it.

I used 9 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings.
